# Gemini Power Kit

> Gemini Power Kit is a browser extension for Google Gemini. It adds Chat Outline navigation, Quick Follow-up quote-and-reply actions, Chain Prompt automation, custom Gem avatars, tab title sync, reply-completion notifications, open-in-new-tab workflows, and theme customization.

This website documents the public product, installation flow, feature behavior, troubleshooting guidance, release notes, and privacy policy for Gemini Power Kit. English pages are the canonical documentation set, with Chinese pages available under `/zh-cn/`.

## Official Links

- [Official Website](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/): Product overview and primary documentation entry point.
- [Chrome Web Store Listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ihakfpnmefdkllhkecanagmienfnmojn): Official install page for Gemini Power Kit.
- [Firefox Add-ons Listing](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/gemini-power-kit/): Official Firefox installation.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/RonkTsang/gemini-chat-extension): Source repository for the extension.

## Core Docs

- [Install](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/guide/install/): Chrome and Firefox store installation, settings entry, and setup troubleshooting.
- [Quick Start](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/guide/quick-start/): First steps after installation.
- [Features Overview](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/): Index of the main feature pages.

## Tips And Tutorials

- [Tips & Tutorials](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/tips/): Task-focused guides with examples and practical Gemini Power Kit usage tips.
- [Navigate Long Gemini Chats with Chat Outline](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/tips/find-earlier-gemini-prompts/): Browse Chat Outline as a clickable table of contents for the current Gemini conversation’s prompts and attachments, including image thumbnails, video covers, and file details. Select an entry to navigate directly to its message.
- [Change Gemini Chat Background and Theme](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/tips/change-gemini-background/): Start with a Theme Bloom image drop to change the Gemini chat background and color preset, then adjust readability or troubleshoot common issues.

- [Delete Multiple Gemini Chats at Once](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/tips/delete-multiple-gemini-chats/): Select chats individually or choose a recent batch, exclude pinned chats from quick selection, review the count, and confirm deletion.
- [Get Notified When Gemini Finishes](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/tips/get-notified-when-gemini-finishes/): Set up Gemini reply and Deep Research desktop notifications, add an optional Chromium notification sound, and troubleshoot missing completion alerts.
- [Quote a Gemini Response and Ask a Follow-up](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/tips/ask-follow-up-about-gemini-response/): Select text in a Gemini response, choose Ask Gemini to quote and reply manually, or run a saved follow-up prompt with automatic sending.
- [Make Gemini Chat Wider](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/tips/make-gemini-chat-wider/): Use Chat layout to increase Gemini chat width or use the full available page width for code and tables, adjust input width independently, and restore defaults.

## Features

- [Chat Outline](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/chat-outline/): Navigate long Gemini conversations and jump between key sections.
- [Quick Follow-up](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/quick-follow-up/): Ask contextual follow-up questions from selected text and saved prompts.
- [Chain Prompt](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/chain-prompt/): Build reusable multi-step Gemini prompt workflows.
- [Open in New Tab](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/stuff-open-new-tab/): Open Gemini Library items in new tabs without interrupting the current page.
- [Tab Title Sync](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/tab-title-sync/): Sync browser tab titles with Gemini conversation titles.
- [Gemini Reply Completion Notifications](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/notifications/): Receive system notifications when Gemini finishes replying.
- [Gemini Bulk Delete Chats](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/bulk-delete/): Select multiple recent Gemini chats, exclude pinned conversations, and delete an intentional batch at once.
- [Theme Customizer](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/theme/): Customize Gemini appearance with themes, colors, wallpaper, readability controls, and Theme Bloom image-drop interactions that match a wallpaper to a color preset.
- [Gemini Chat Layout Settings](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/chat-layout/): Adjust Gemini chat and prompt widths, user-message alignment, and full-width messages from the top bar or Theme settings.
- [Gem Avatar](https://gpk.ronktsang.com/features/gem-avatar/): Give each Gemini Gem a custom local avatar, then make its character easier to recognize in chats.
